title: AccountHolder - Payment Module Data Models Reference

blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the AccountHolder data model. It belongs to the Payment Module.

types.name: id
types.description: The ID of the account holder.

types.name: provider_id
types.description: The ID of the payment provider storing the account holder's saved payment methods.

types.name: external_id
types.description: The ID of the account holder in the payment provider's system.

types.name: email
types.description: The email of the account holder

types.name: data
types.description: The data returned by the payment provider when the account holder is created.

types.name: metadata
types.description: Holds custom data in key-value pairs.
